notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken artifact creature.
You control less than four Blood tokens.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a nontoken artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Voldaren Bloodcaster and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Voldaren Bloodcaster trigger, creating a Blood artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Blood token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return the artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
